title: Lumbar (T12-S1) peak forward flexion, IMU
condition: healthy, standing, upright to full forward flexion

quantity.name: range of flexion
quantity.definition: Sagittal rotation relative to initial upright posture; trunk = T1 vs global, pelvis = S1 vs global, lumbar = T12 vs S1, upper thorax = T1 vs T5, lower thorax = T5 vs T12, total thorax = T1 vs T12; peak at maximum voluntary flexion

source.sample: 40 males; 40 young healthy male students, no history of back surgery or recent back/hip/knee complications

protocol.summary: Peak voluntary forward flexion from neutral upright standing; segment ROMs from 4 skin-mounted inertial sensors.

measurement.device: Xsens MTx inertial sensors (4) on T1, T5, T12 and S1 spinous processes, 100 Hz
measurement.task: slow (4-5 s) forward flexion from neutral upright to maximum voluntary flexion, 3 trials

how_to_use: Distribute ~50 deg (SD 7) lumbar flexion over T12-S1 at full trunk flexion (118 deg).
Split per level with a separate segmental-ratio source; this study gives only the total.

data.x: lumbar T12 vs S1, full flexion

extraction.check_notes: Re-read abstract and Section 3.1; values identical in both places.

pass_rule.rule: input data – not graded; use for robustness checks
